Bayaran fi

8.  (1)  Fi yang kena dibayar kepada Lembaga  berhubung dengan
penyerahsimpanan atau pemfailan dokumen hendaklah dibayar semasa dokumen itu
diserahkan atau difailkan.

(2)  Jika fi kena dibayar bagi atau berhubung dengan penyerah simpanan atau
pemfailan dokumen dan dokumen itu diserahkan atau difailk an tanpa bayaran fi,
dokumen itu disifatkan tidak diserahkan atau difailkan sehingga fi itu dibayar.

(3)  Jika fi kena dibayar bagi atau berhubung dengan apa -apa perkara yang
melibatkan perbuatan apa -apa tindakan atau benda oleh Lembaga, Lembaga
mempunyai kuasa untuk enggan melakukan tindakan atau benda itu sehinggalah fi itu
dibayar.

Pembatalan

LABUAN FINANCIAL SERVICES AUTHORITY ACT 1996

LABUAN FINANCIAL SERVICES AUTHORITY (PROCESSING AND APPROVAL FEES)
(LABUAN FINANCIAL INSTITUTIONS) ORDER 2012

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 32A of the Labuan Financial Services
Authority Act 1996 [Act 545], the Authority, with the approval of the Minister makes the
following order:

Citation and commencement
1. (1) This order may be cited as the Labuan Financial Services Authority
(Processing and Approval Fees) (Labuan Financial Institutions) Order 2012.

 (2) This Order comes into operation on 1 January 2013.

Fee for matters under the Labuan Financial Services and Securities Act 2010
2. The fees prescribed in the First Schedule shall be charged for the services
provided by the Authority under the  Labuan Financial Services and Securities Act 2010
[Act 704].

Fee for matters under the Labuan Islamic Financial Services and Securities
Act 2010
3. The fees prescribed in the Second Schedule shall be charged for the services
provided by the Authority under the  Labuan Islamic Financi al Services and Securities
Act 2010 [Act 705].

Fee for matters under the Labuan Trusts Act 1996
4. The fees prescribed in the Third Schedule shall be charged for the services
provided by the Authority under the Labuan Trusts Act 1996 [Act 554].

Fee for matters under the Labuan Companies Act 1990
5. The fees prescribed in the Fourth Schedule shall be charged for the services
provided by the Authority under the Labuan Companies Act 1990 [Act 441].

Fee for matters under the Labuan Foundations Act 2010
6.  The fees prescribed in the Fifth Schedule shall be charged for the services
provided by the Authority under the Labuan Foundations Act 2010 [Act 706].

Fee for matters under the Labuan Limited Partnerships and Limited Liability
Partnerships Act 2010
7.  The fees prescribed in the Sixth Schedule shall be charged for the services
provided by the Authority under the Labuan Limited Partnerships and Limited Liability
Partnerships Act 2010 [Act 707].

Payment of fees
8. (1)  The fees payable to the Authority in relation to the lodgement or filing of a
document shall be paid at the time the document is lodged or filed.

(2)  Where a fee is payable for or in relation to the lodgement or filing of a
document and the document is lodged or filed without payment of the fee, the document
is deemed not to have been lodged or filed until the fee has been paid.

(3)  Where a fee is payable for or in relation to any matter involving the doing
of any act or thing by the Authority, the Authority has the power to refuse to do tha t act
or thing until the fee has been paid.

Revocation
9. The Labuan Financial Services Authority (Processing and Approval Fees)
(Labuan Financial Institutions) Order 2010 [P.U. (A) 413/2010] is revoked.
